title: H7 fix round 2: test_flaky_rerun_then_escalate asserts the old pytest command while the rerun now uses the worktree's runner; align the assertion with the new command shape (test id present, timeout set) without weakening it (gate_red on T-0412)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain b9c2972, fb696ce and 4a605cc (T-0364, T-0412) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Gate red on T-0412 (daemon run): tests/test_daemon.py::Daemon::test_flaky_rerun_then_escalate fails with AssertionError: Lists differ: ['/Users/.../wt/T-0412/.venv/bin/python', ..., 'tests/test_x.py::test_x'] != ['pytest', '-q', 'tests/test_x.py::test_x']. Confirm test_flaky_rerun_has_timeout_and_timeout_is_not_flaky still passes. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0 (whole suite), then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
